question: After provisioning distributed Flask HS256 2-node with shared store (Redis or shared SQLite WAL at /tmp/spider-runtime-35784838353/shared.db) and gunicorn 23.0.0 2x sync + nginx 1.24.0 round-robin delivering real requests (If-None-Match/ETag->304 verified, per-batch SELECT commitment verified, X-Worker-Pid distribution >=10 per worker, n_non304>=800 stratified), does C-FRESHNESS orthogonality at delta=0.15 achieve C1 detection TN>=0.85 (Wilson lower>0.75, per-endpoint session_status>=0.85 vs per-node baseline TN~0.667) and maintain stratified r TOST within 0.15 (p<0.05) with confound detection |r|>0.9, thereby unblocking Graph and Runtime downstream freshness-gated inheritance and delta-repair with honest kernel-gated counters?
hypothesis: C-FRESHNESS orthogonality at delta=0.15 will be CONFIRMED on distributed shared-store infrastructure after fixing the sole C1 failure mode from EXP-GRAPH-35611618323. Replacing per-node independent SQLite session DBs with a shared store (Redis, or shared SQLite WAL at /tmp/spider-runtime-35784838353/shared.db accessed by both gunicorn workers) and serving through gunicorn 23.0.0 2x sync + nginx 1.24.0 round-robin will restore C1 behavioral detection TN from 0.667 (0.0 on /api/session/status) to >=0.85 (Wilson lower>0.75, per-endpoint session_status>=0.85) while preserving orthogonality correlation: stratified pooled r within [-0.15,0.15], 95% CI upper<0.15, TOST p_upper<0.05 at delta=0.15, with confound |r|>=0.90 sensitivity retained. Prior evidence: HS256 shared TESTBED_SECRET already fixed token cross-node validation (TP=1.0, r=-0.038 CI upper 0.029 TOST p=2.0e-08 n_non304=844 audit PASS); only session replication caused TN failure (audit V-C1-TN-RECOMPUTED: valid session/status deltas 3.0 vs 0.0 local). Shared store eliminates session-affinity failure without coupling behavioral and structural signals.
falsifier: C-FRESHNESS orthogonality at delta=0.15 on distributed shared-store infrastructure is FALSIFIED (REJECTED) if ANY of the following occurs under valid shared-store + gunicorn+nginx delivery: (F1) C1 behavioral detection mean TN <0.85 on B-DISTRIBUTED-SHARED (after 304 exclusion) OR Wilson 95% lower bound <=0.75 OR per-endpoint /api/session/status TN <0.85; (F2) fewer than 2/3 endpoints have non-304 behavioral std>0 OR <2/3 have non-304 structural std>0; (F3) 95% CI upper bound of endpoint-stratified pooled Pearson r (non-304 only) >=0.15; (F4) TOST equivalence p_upper >=0.05 at delta=0.15 (one-sided, non-304); (F5) endpoint-stratified cache-mode heterogeneity |r_enabled - r_disabled| >=2*SE_pooled; (F6) B-LOCAL-ONLY baseline shows |r|>=0.15 (regression); (F7) B-CONFOUND-DISTRIBUTED shows endpoint-stratified weighted |r|<0.90 (confound fails to reproduce at stricter threshold; prior 0.912 threshold tightened to 0.90 per director mandate). Also FALSIFIED if primary stratified r differs from prior distributed estimate by >0.10 absolute (requires confound detection |r|>0.9 remains but primary |r| drifts beyond 0.15, indicating coupling introduced by shared store). MEASUREMENT_INVALID if shared-store/real-request validity preconditions fail (see measurement_validity) or n_non304_shared <400.

baselines.description: Single-node Flask HS256 control, no distribution — identical to EXP-GRAPH-35538864957/35611618323 LOCAL. Regression guard: verifies |r|<0.15 not degraded by code changes. Independent SQLite DB, no nginx.
baselines.expected: |r| <0.15, consistent with prior r=0.041-0.058 CI upper 0.09-0.125, TOST PASS, n_non304>=400

baselines.description: 2-node independent per-node SQLite + HS256 shared TESTBED_SECRET + round-robin (no shared store, no nginx/gunicorn) — exact replication of EXP-GRAPH-35611618323 failing baseline. Expected to reproduce TN~0.667 (session_status 0.0) and r=-0.038 CI upper 0.029. This is the falsification reference, not the treatment.
baselines.expected: TN ~0.667 (mean 0.666, session_status 0.0) matching prior; |r| <0.15 (r=-0.038) confirming prior correlation; used as comparator for C1 improvement delta >=0.18

baselines.description: PRIMARY TREATMENT: 2-node Flask HS256 with SHARED STORE (Redis OR shared SQLite WAL at /tmp/spider-runtime-35784838353/shared.db, WAL journal_mode, shared ETag/session table) + gunicorn 23.0.0 2x sync workers + nginx 1.24.0 round-robin reverse-proxy delivering REAL HTTP requests. Verifies C1 rescue while preserving orthogonality. Shared store is the single manipulated variable vs B-DISTRIBUTED-PER-NODE.
baselines.expected: TN >=0.85 Wilson lower>0.75 per-endpoint session_status>=0.85, |r| <0.15 CI upper<0.15 TOST p<0.05, confound |r|>0.90 not applicable here (primary metric)

baselines.description: Distributed shared-store negative control with V2 confound (fixed 'expired' request_id for expired, uuid4 for valid) on same gunicorn+nginx+shared-store substrate as B-DISTRIBUTED-SHARED. Tests pipeline sensitivity under shared store: must still produce |r|>=0.90.
baselines.expected: |r| >=0.90 (prior |r|=0.912 on per-node; shared store should not attenuate confound below 0.90)

positive_control.description: Token validation failure detection on distributed shared-store with HS256 shared TESTBED_SECRET: behavioral signal must identify expired vs valid tokens with mean TP>=0.85 and mean TN>=0.85 (after 304 exclusion) across all endpoints. With shared store, valid-token+session_id MUST route to either worker and still validate (session lookup hits shared DB), so valid behavioral_delta==0.
positive_control.threshold: mean TP >=0.85 AND mean TN >=0.85 AND Wilson lower TN >0.75 AND session_status TN >=0.85

null_control.description: Structural signal std>0 on all non-304 conditions (independent ETag/Cache-Control/UUID entropy) and confound positive: B-CONFOUND-DISTRIBUTED-SHARED |r|>=0.90 proves pipeline would detect coupling if present. Primary stratified |r| <0.15 with TOST PASS demonstrates absence of coupling is not insensitive measurement. Also C2 variance: >=2/3 endpoints std>0 for both signals.
null_control.threshold: C2 >=2/3 endpoints variance >0; C3 CI upper <0.15; C4 TOST p_upper<0.05; C7 |r|>=0.90
null_control.expected: C2 3/3 PASS, C3 r~ -0.04 CI upper ~0.03 PASS, C4 p~2e-08 PASS, C7 |r|~0.91 PASS

measurement_validity: SHARED STORE VALIDITY (manipulated variable): Distributed testbed MUST use shared Redis (any version, localhost 6379) OR shared SQLite WAL at exact path /tmp/spider-runtime-35784838353/shared.db with journal_mode=WAL, synchronous=NORMAL, shared by both Flask workers. Verify by per-batch SELECT: after each batch, query shared store row count from a separate process and assert >=100% writes committed (commit_verified). Per-node SQLite files (e.g., /tmp/*.db per worker) are PROHIBITED for B-DISTRIBUTED-SHARED; their presence triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Log store type (redis|sqlite-wal) and SHARED_TESTBED_SECRET sharing.

GUNICORN+NGINX REAL-REQUEST VALIDITY: B-DISTRIBUTED-SHARED MUST be served via gunicorn 23.0.0 2x sync workers (gunicorn --workers 2 --worker-class sync) behind nginx 1.24.0 round-robin upstream (proxy_pass to 127.0.0.1:18971 and 18972 or unix sockets with round-robin). Requests in experiment MUST go through nginx port (not directly to Flask). Verify by X-Worker-Pid header: collect X-Worker-Pid on every non-304 response, assert distribution >=10 responses per worker pid (proof of round-robin), and log nginx access log excerpt. Direct-to-Flask routing triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

IF-NONE-MATCH/ETAG->304 VALIDITY: Real HTTP cache behavior must be exercised: for each endpoint, send second GET with If-None-Match: <prior ETag> and verify 304 response observed on at least one sample per endpoint-batch (304_verified). Also verify ETag header present on 200 responses. Log 304 counts per baseline; if 0 304s across entire B-DISTRIBUTED-SHARED, flag measurement anomaly (cache may be bypassed). Prior rate ~16% (164/1008) expected; deviation does not invalidate but must be logged.

NON-304 POWER: n_non304 >=800 stratified pooled samples on B-DISTRIBUTED-SHARED (target: 42 per condition per endpoint x 8 conditions x 3 endpoints =1008 total, ~84% non-304 ~844). MEASUREMENT_INVALID if n_non304_shared <400. Power justification: prior CI half-width ~0.067 at n=800, sufficient for delta=0.15 TOST.

HS256 SYMMETRIC JWT PRESERVED: testbed_server.py MUST use HS256 with shared TESTBED_SECRET (os.environ.get), not RS256 per-process RSA. Single SHARED_TESTBED_SECRET generated once and passed to both workers (not per-worker secrets). Already verified in parent; re-verify via grep HS256 present, RS256 not used for signing. Preserve V_ETAG_PERMISSION_LEAKAGE fix (expired tokens decoded without verification for ETag).

C1 304-EXCLUSION: C1 behavioral detection excludes 304 responses from TP/TN (304 is HTTP cache artifact, not behavioral delta). Pooled correlations also exclude 304s. Endpoint-stratified pooling, headers-only structural signal (ETag change, Cache-Control change, normalized Shannon entropy, SHA256(request_id)[:16]), behavioral signal formula token*2+session*3+auth*1+status*2 preserved from parent.

DISTRIBUTED INDEPENDENCE EXCEPT SHARED STORE: Each Flask node's in-memory CDN cache remains independent (invalidation not propagated) except session/ETag table in shared DB. Cache independence and UUID-for-all-status-codes (primary) vs fixed 'expired' (confound) preserved.

TOST ONE-SIDED: C3 tests CI upper <0.15 only; C4 tests TOST p_upper <0.05 at delta=0.15 (one-sided). B-CONFOUND threshold tightened to |r|>=0.90 per director mandate (vs prior 0.15) to demand strong confound replication on shared store.

BYTE-PRESERVING HIT-CACHE RETAINED (dependency): nginx byte-preserving HIT-cache 960/960 oracle-free greedy decode (runtime lane) remains available but not re-tested here; this experiment does not break that cache and logs that nginx cache path is not conflated with behavioral signals (structural signal remains headers-only).

STRATIFIED POOLED R DEGENERATE HANDLING: per-endpoint constant signals (std==0) excluded from stratified pooling and flagged in metrics.b_*_strat_degenerate, not propagated as NaN, per parent Change 3.

WILSON INTERVAL SPEC: C1 TN Wilson 95% lower bound computed via Wilson score interval (z=1.96) on valid-token non-304 samples pooled across endpoints. Also report per-endpoint TN and Wilson lower; session_status endpoint is primary diagnostic (prior 0.0, must reach >=0.85).

SAMPLE COMPOSITION LOGGING: Log n_samples per baseline (total, non304, 304), per-endpoint n, per-worker X-Worker-Pid counts, ETag counts, 304 counts, store type, gunicorn/nginx versions (23.0.0/1.24.0), shared.db path/sha256 if SQLite WAL used.
decision_rule: C-FRESHNESS orthogonality at delta=0.15 on distributed SHARED-STORE + gunicorn+nginx is CONFIRMED iff ALL hold on B-DISTRIBUTED-SHARED (after 304 exclusion) AND baselines: (C1) behavioral detection mean TP>=0.85 AND mean TN>=0.85 with Wilson 95% lower TN>0.75 AND per-endpoint /api/session/status TN>=0.85 AND improvement delta vs B-DISTRIBUTED-PER-NODE >=0.15 (TN_shared - 0.667 >=0.15); (C2) >=2/3 endpoints have non-304 behavioral std>0 AND >=2/3 have non-304 structural std>0; (C3) 95% CI upper bound of endpoint-stratified pooled r (non304) <0.15; (C4) TOST p_upper <0.05 at delta=0.15 (one-sided, non304); (C5) |r_enabled - r_disabled| <2*SE_pooled (cache-mode heterogeneity); (C6) B-LOCAL-ONLY |r|<0.15 (no regression); (C7) B-CONFOUND-DISTRIBUTED-SHARED |r|>=0.90 (negative control, stricter than prior 0.15); (V1) real-request validity: X-Worker-Pid >=10 per worker + If-None-Match/ETag->304 verified + per-batch SELECT commitment verified; (V2) n_non304_shared >=800 (or >=400 with CI half-width<=0.08 otherwise MEASUREMENT_INVALID). If ANY C1-C7/V1 fails, outcome FALSIFIES (per frozen precedence: falsification checked before MEASUREMENT_INVALID). MEASUREMENT_INVALID only if n_non304_shared<400 OR shared-store/gunicorn/nginx validity fails OR infrastructure prevents data collection (no valid metrics). Positive and negative outcomes are both high-information: CONFIRMED unblocks freshness-gated inheritance/delta-repair; FALSIFIED identifies shared-store coupling or residual affinity bug.
product_consequence_positive: C-FRESHNESS moves HYPOTHESIS -> EXPERIMENTAL on distributed shared-store production-like topology (2-node Flask HS256 + shared Redis/SQLite WAL + gunicorn 23.0.0 2x sync + nginx 1.24.0 round-robin, real HTTP 304 behavior preserved). C1 TN>=0.85 Wilson lower>0.75 with session_status>=0.85 while stratified r remains within 0.15 (CI upper<0.15 TOST p<0.05) demonstrates orthogonal behavioral/structural freshness signals survive distribution with shared session state. Parallel-channel freshness detection (separate behavioral and structural processing) is justified for multi-node deployment with shared store or equivalent session affinity. Directly unblocks downstream gates: C-DELTA-REPAIR localized repair (6 prior BLOCKED awaiting HIT-cache 960/960 + freshness), C-LLM-INHERIT/C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY freshness gating 0.25 in Product economics, and Runtime's honest kernel-gated counters (resolve+bind+verify+freshness+browser_steps) as specified in director dependencies. No promotion to VALIDATED/PRODUCT_CORE—still Flask localhost, not real CDN.
product_consequence_negative: C-FRESHNESS remains HYPOTHESIS (bounded FALSIFIED) on distributed shared-store: either C1 rescue fails (TN<0.85 or Wilson lower<=0.75 or session_status<0.85) indicating shared store does not resolve session affinity or introduces new coupling, OR orthogonality correlation fails (CI upper>=0.15 or TOST p>=0.05) indicating shared store couples behavioral and structural signals, OR confound sensitivity lost (|r|<0.90). Product must NOT deploy parallel-channel freshness on this topology without sticky affinity or externalized session redesign; fused classifiers or alternative freshness signals may be needed. Negative result still unblocks intelligence: it prevents unsafe inheritance (false accepts) and identifies the single architectural variable (shared store vs still-missing affinity) that must be fixed before Graph and Runtime can rely on freshness-gated inheritance/delta-repair. If MEASUREMENT_INVALID (shared store, gunicorn, nginx, or 304/SELECT validity fails or n<400), no C-FRESHNESS inference—repair infra exactly (shared.db WAL mode, X-Worker-Pid proof, SELECT commitment) and re-run; do not revert to per-node pilot.
estimated_cost: Low: (1) infra provisioning ~30 min: provision shared store (Redis apt install or mkdir -p /tmp/spider-runtime-35784838353 && touch shared.db && sqlite3 PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL) + install gunicorn 23.0.0 + nginx 1.24.0 config with upstream round-robin + verify X-Worker-Pid + ETAG/304 + SELECT commitment; (2) execution: 4 baselines x 1008 samples = ~4032 HTTP requests (~60 min at 1 req/50ms + nginx hop); (3) analysis: stratified r CI/TOST/Wilson, per-endpoint TN, worker distribution, 304/SELECT verification (~15 min). Total ~2-2.5 compute-hours. Reuses testbed_server.py HS256 and NumpyEncoder fixes from parent.
expected_information_gain: Very high — minimum-cost experiment that changes C-FRESHNESS claim and unblocks two lanes. Prior EXP-GRAPH-35611618323 was 90% solved: orthogonality correlation CONFIRMED on distributed (r=-0.038 CI upper 0.029 TOST p=2e-08) with only C1 TN=0.667 failing due to session non-replication (single architectural variable). This experiment manipulates exactly that variable (shared store + real nginx routing) and tests both the fix (TN>=0.85 Wilson lower>0.75 vs 0.667) and preservation (r within 0.15, |r|>0.9 confound). Positive outcome closes distributed freshness gap and unblocks C-DELTA-REPAIR (6 BLOCKED) and freshness-gated C-LLM-INHERIT/C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY economics. Negative outcome is equally decisive: identifies genuine shared-store coupling or residual affinity barrier beyond per-node SQLite, preventing unsafe parallel-channel product. Either outcome eliminates the highest-leverage unknown from Director's portfolio assessment (70% recent MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED due to substrate).
